title: Centralize cross-PC MAP SQLite authority on RUKI
description: Make RUKI the sole writable MAP database authority; give KUDU a read-only atomic mirror and a forced-command, allowlisted SSH gateway for lifecycle operations; disable local writer services on KUDU; preserve visibility and fail closed on remote or validation failure.
acceptance_criteria: RUKI is the only writable production map.db and KUDU direct production-DB mutation fails closed.
KUDU refreshes a validated, consistent SQLite backup and canonical task mirrors atomically enough that readers never observe a partial database file.
A dedicated forced-command SSH key exposes only allowlisted lifecycle and snapshot operations; malformed, unknown, oversized, or injection-shaped requests are rejected and tested.
Claim, heartbeat, map_task lifecycle, route, and review-claim operations execute on RUKI with structured results and preserve existing MAP gates.
Installer templates support authority and mirror services without changing the default single-host installation mode.
Functional tests, failure-mode tests, and a separate security-framed review pass before activation on KUDU.
